description: Unified skill for Microsoft Word .docx workflows: extracting comments or tracked changes, summarizing reviewer feedback, generating response-to-comments documents, building Word memos or reports, applying tracked edits, auditing OOXML internals, validating and repairing documents, accepting revisions, adding or resolving comments, converting legacy .doc files, unpacking or repacking .docx files, simplifying redline markup, rendering .docx to images, and building Word documents with tables of contents, multi-column layouts, or page-numbered headers and footers.
